dslRule:
<!id: string.indexOfToContains>
<!description: Replace String.indexOf("literal") != -1 with String.contains("literal") for checking substring presence.>
<!severity: HINT>

$s.indexOf($literal) != -1 :: instanceof($s, "java.lang.String") && isStringLiteral($literal)
=>
$s.contains($literal)
;;
summary: Replaces String.indexOf(String literal) != -1 with String.contains(String literal) for checking substring existence.
